rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「재난 및 안전관리 기본법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(긴급구조지원기관) 「재난 및 안전관리 기본법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제4조제7호에서 “행정안전부령으로 정하는 기관 및 단체”란 별표 1에 규정된 기관 및 단체를 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Emergency Rescue Support Agencies) In Article 4, Subparagraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “agencies and organizations prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety” refers to the agencies and organizations specified in Annex 1. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(지방자치단체의 재난 및 안전관리 사업예산의 사전검토 등) ① 「재난 및 안전관리 기본법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제10조의4제1항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “사업의 집행 실적 및 성과, 향후 사업 추진 필요성 등 행정안전부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2024. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Prior Review, etc. of Budgets for Disaster and Safety Management Projects by Local Governments) ① In the part other than each subparagraph of Article 10-4, Paragraph 1 of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the phrase “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, such as performance records and results of project execution and the necessity of future project promotion” refers to the following matters: <Amended June 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 재난 및 안전관리 사업의 집행 실적 및 성과
rows.text_en: 1. Execution Performance and Achievements of Disaster and Safety Management Projects

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 지역의 재난ㆍ사고 피해 현황, 위험 전망 등 재난 및 안전관리 사업의 추진 필요성
rows.text_en: 2. Necessity of promoting disaster and safety management projects, including the current status of disaster and accident damage and risk outlook in the relevant region

rows.source_ko: 3. 재난ㆍ사고의 예방 등 재난 및 안전관리 사업의 기대효과
rows.text_en: 3. Expected effects of disaster and safety management projects, such as disaster and accident prevention

rows.source_ko: 4. 국가 및 지방자치단체(「제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법」 제10조제2항에 따른 행정시를 포함한다. 이하 같다)의 재난 및 안전관리에 관한 중요 정책
rows.text_en: 4. Important policies regarding disaster and safety management of the State and local governments (including administrative cities pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of an International Free City; hereinafter the same applies)

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 지방자치단체의 장이 투자우선순위 검토를 위하여 고려할 필요가 있다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters that the head of the local government deems necessary to consider for the review of investment priorities

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제10조의4제1항제5호에서 “행정안전부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 다음 각 호의 사업을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 10-4, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the Act, “businesses prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety” refers to the businesses listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 재난 및 안전관리에 관한 연구개발 사업
rows.text_en: 1. Research and development projects regarding disaster and safety management

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 지방자치단체의 장이 사업예산의 사전검토가 필요하다고 인정하여 행정안전부장관과 협의하여 정하는 재난 및 안전관리 사업
rows.text_en: 2. Other disaster and safety management projects determined by the head of a local government in consultation with the Minister of the Interior and Safety, as deemed necessary for prior review of the project budget.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 9, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(중앙재난안전대책본부의 구성 및 운영 등) ① 법 제14조제1항에 따른 중앙재난안전대책본부(이하 “중앙대책본부”라 한다)의 본부장은 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 중앙대책본부의 구성 및 운영기준을 정하여 시행할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 8. 11., 2020. 12. 9.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Composition and Operation, etc. of the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasure Headquarters) ① The Head of the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasure Headquarters pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Central Headquarters”) may establish and implement standards for the composition and operation of the Central Headquarters that include the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Aug. 11, 2015; Dec. 9, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중앙대책본부의 구성 및 구성원의 임무와 역할에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the composition of the Central Countermeasure Headquarters and the duties and roles of its members

rows.source_ko: 2. 재난 및 안전사고에 대한 중앙대책본부의 단계별 운영체계 및 실무반 편성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the phased operational system and working group organization of the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasure Headquarters for disasters and safety accidents

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제14조의2제1항에 따른 수습지원단의 파견 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the dispatch, etc. of the trainee support group pursuant to Article 14-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제14조의2제2항에 따른 특수기동구조대의 편성 및 파견 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the organization and dispatch, etc. of the Special Mobile Rescue Unit pursuant to Article 14-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제18조제1항제1호에 따른 중앙재난안전상황실의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the operation of the Central Disaster and Safety Situation Room pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act
6. Matters concerning the operation of meetings of the Central Countermeasure Headquarters

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 중앙대책본부의 본부장(이하 “중앙대책본부장”이라 한다)이 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters deemed necessary by the Head of the Central Countermeasure Headquarters (hereinafter referred to as the “Head of the Central Countermeasure Headquarters”)

rows.source_ko: ② 중앙대책본부장은 재난이 발생하거나 재난이 발생할 우려가 있는 경우에 상황에 따른 적절한 판단을 내리기 위하여 필요할 때에는 행정안전부 및 재난과 관련된 중앙행정기관의 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원 등으로 구성된 상황판단회의를 구성ㆍ운영할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Central Disaster Management Headquarters may establish and operate a Situation Assessment Council composed of officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and central administrative agencies related to the disaster, when necessary to make appropriate judgments based on the situation in the event that a disaster occurs or there is a risk of a disaster occurring. <Amended Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 상황판단회의의 구성ㆍ운영에 관한 사항은 중앙대책본부장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Matters concerning the composition and operation of the situation assessment meeting pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall be determined by the Head of the Central Countermeasure Headquarters.

[Wholly Amended Feb. 7, 2014]
[Title Amended Dec. 9, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(지방자치단체장 재난안전관리교육의 횟수 등) ① 지방자치단체의 장은 임기 중 2회 이상 영 제21조의3제1항에 따른 지방자치단체장 재난안전관리교육(이하 “지방자치단체장 재난안전관리교육”이라 한다)을 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Number of Disaster Safety Management Education for Heads of Local Governments, etc.) ① The head of a local government shall receive disaster safety management education for heads of local governments pursuant to Article 21-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “disaster safety management education for heads of local governments”) at least twice during their term of office.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 지방자치단체장 재난안전관리교육 실시에 관한 세부 사항은 행정안전부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, detailed matters concerning the implementation of disaster safety management education for heads of local governments shall be determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 26, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(재난상황의 보고 등) ① 법 제20조제1항에 따라 시장(「제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법」 제11조제1항에 따른 행정시장을 포함한다. 이하 같다)ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다), 소방서장, 해양경찰서장, 법 제3조제5호나목에 따른 재난관리책임기관의 장 또는 법 제26조제1항에 따른 국가핵심기반의 장(이하 “재난상황의 보고자”라 한다)은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 재난상황을 보고해야 한다. <개정 2014. 2. 7., 2015. 8. 11., 2017. 2. 3., 2017. 7. 26., 2020. 6. 4., 2021. 6. 10., 2023. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Reporting of Disaster Situations, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the Mayor (including the Administrative Mayor pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of an International Free City; hereinafter the same applies), County Governor, District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district; hereinafter the same applies), Fire Chief, Coast Guard Chief, Head of a Disaster Management Agency pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 5, Item (b) of the Act, or Head of a National Core Infrastructure pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Reporter of Disaster Situation”) shall report disaster situations according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Feb. 7, 2014; Aug. 11, 2015; Feb. 3, 2017; Jul. 26, 2017; Jun. 4, 2020; Jun. 10, 2021; Jun. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 최초 보고: 인명피해 등 주요 재난 발생 시 지체 없이 서면(전자문서를 포함한다), 팩스, 전화, 법 제34조의8제1항에 따른 재난안전통신망 중 가장 빠른 방법으로 하는 보고
rows.text_en: 1. Initial Report: In the event of a major disaster, such as one involving casualties, a report made without delay in writing (including electronic documents), by fax, by telephone, or via the fastest method among the disaster safety communication networks under Article 34-8, Paragraph 1 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 2. 중간 보고: 별지 제1호서식(법 제3조제1호가목에 따른 재난의 경우에는 별지 제2호서식)에 따라 전산시스템 등을 활용하여 재난 수습기간 중에 수시로 하는 보고
rows.text_en: 2. Interim Report: A report submitted from time to time during the disaster recovery period using computerized systems, etc., in accordance with Form No. 1 (Form No. 2 in the case of a disaster pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 1, Item (a) of the Act).

rows.source_ko: 3. 최종 보고: 재난 수습이 끝나거나 재난이 소멸된 후 영 제24조제1항에 따른 사항을 종합하여 하는 보고
rows.text_en: 3. Final Report: A report compiling the matters under Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree after disaster containment is completed or the disaster has ceased.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제20조제1항에 따라 재난상황의 보고자는 응급조치 내용을 별지 제3호서식의 응급복구조치 상황 및 별지 제4호서식의 응급구호조치 상황으로 구분하여 재난기간 중 1일 2회 이상 보고하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 2. 7., 2015. 8. 11., 2017. 2. 3.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act, a reporter of a disaster situation shall report the details of emergency measures at least twice a day during the disaster period, classifying them into the status of emergency restoration measures (Form No. 3) and the status of emergency relief measures (Form No. 4). <Amended Feb. 7, 2014; Aug. 11, 2015; Feb. 3, 2017>
③ Deleted <Jan. 7, 2020>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(재난상황의 보고 대상) 영 제24조제2항에 따라 재난상황의 보고자가 보고해야 하는 재난의 종류와 규모는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Reporting Subjects of Disaster Situations) Pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the types and scales of disasters that a reporter of a disaster situation must report are as follows:
1. Disaster pursuant to Annex 1-3 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 「접경지역 지원 특별법」 제2조제1호에 따른 접경지역에 있는 하천의 급격한 수량 증가나 제방의 붕괴 등을 일으켜 인명 또는 재산에 피해를 줄 수 있는 댐의 방류
rows.text_en: 2. Discharge from dams that may cause damage to life or property by causing a sudden increase in water volume in rivers or the collapse of levees in border areas pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Special Act on Support for Border Areas

rows.source_ko: 3. 단일 사고로서 사망 3명 이상(화재 또는 교통사고의 경우에는 5명 이상을 말한다) 또는 부상 20명 이상의 재난
rows.text_en: 3. A disaster resulting in 3 or more deaths (5 or more in the case of a fire or traffic accident) or 20 or more injuries as a single accident
[Wholly Amended July 1, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(특정관리대상지역의 지정 및 해제 통보 등) 영 제31조제3항에 따라 중앙행정기관의 장 또는 지방자치단체의 장은 법 제27조제1항에 따른 특정관리대상지역을 지정하거나 해제할 때에는 그 사실을 다음 각 호의 방법으로 해당 지역의 소유자ㆍ관리자 또는 점유자에게 알려 주어야 한다. <개정 2014. 2. 7., 2015. 8. 11., 2018. 1. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Notification of Designation and Removal of Specific Management Areas, etc.) Pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, when the head of a central administrative agency or the head of a local government designates or removes a specific management area pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they shall notify the owner, manager, or occupant of the relevant area of such fact by the methods specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Feb. 7, 2014; Aug. 11, 2015; Jan. 18, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제6호서식에 따른 지정 통보 또는 별지 제7호서식에 따른 해제 통보
rows.text_en: 1. Notification of designation pursuant to Form No. 6 or notification of release pursuant to Form No. 7

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 중앙행정기관 또는 지방자치단체의 공보 또는 게시판에 별지 제8호서식에 따른 지정 또는 해제의 고시
rows.text_en: 2. Notice of designation or revocation pursuant to Form No. 8 in the official gazette or bulletin board of the relevant central administrative agency or local government

[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]
[Title Amended Jan. 18, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(재난안전분야 종사자 교육 종류 등) ① 법 제29조의2에 따른 재난안전분야 종사자 전문교육(이하 이 조에서 “전문교육” 이라 한다)은 관리자 전문교육과 실무자 전문교육으로 구분하며, 그 교육 대상자는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2018. 1. 18., 2020. 1. 7., 2021. 6. 10., 2024. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Types of Training, etc. for Personnel in the Disaster Safety Sector) ① Professional training for personnel in the disaster safety sector pursuant to Article 29-2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “professional training” in this Article) shall be classified into professional training for managers and professional training for practitioners, and the subjects of such training shall be as follows: <Amended Jan. 18, 2018; Jan. 7, 2020; Jun. 10, 2021; Jun. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관리자 전문교육: 다음 각 목에 해당하는 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Professional training for managers: Persons falling under each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 재난관리책임기관에서 재난 및 안전관리 업무를 담당하는 부서의 장
rows.text_en: a. The head of the department responsible for disaster and safety management at the disaster management agency

rows.source_ko: 나. 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도(이하 “시ㆍ도”라 한다)의 부단체장(부단체장이 2명 이상인 경우에는 재난 및 안전관리 업무를 관장하는 부단체장을 말한다)
rows.text_en: B. Deputy heads of Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, Special Self-Governing Cities, Provinces, and Special Self-Governing Provinces (hereinafter referred to as “Cities and Provinces”) (if there are two or more deputy heads, it refers to the deputy head in charge of disaster and safety management affairs)

rows.source_ko: 다. 시(「제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법」 제10조제2항에 따른 행정시를 포함한다. 이하 같다)ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구를 말한다. 이하 같다)의 부단체장(부단체장이 2명 이상인 경우에는 재난 및 안전관리 업무를 관할하는 부단체장을 말한다)
rows.text_en: C. Deputy heads of cities ( including administrative cities pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of an International Free City; hereinafter the same applies), counties, and districts (referring to autonomous districts; hereinafter the same applies) (if there are two or more deputy heads of local governments, it refers to the deputy head with jurisdiction over disaster and safety management affairs)
D. Safety officer pursuant to Article 75-2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 실무자 전문교육: 재난관리책임기관에서 재난 및 안전관리 업무를 담당하는 부서의 공무원 또는 직원으로서 제1호에 해당하지 아니하는 사람
rows.text_en: 2. Specialized training for practitioners: Public officials or employees of departments responsible for disaster and safety management at disaster management agencies who do not fall under Item 1

rows.source_ko: ② 전문교육의 대상자는 해당 업무를 맡은 후 6개월 이내에 신규교육을 받아야 하며, 신규교육을 받은 후 매 2년마다 정기교육을 받아야 한다. <개정 2021. 6. 10.>
rows.text_en: ② Persons subject to specialized training must receive new training within six months of assuming the relevant duties, and must receive regular training every two years thereafter. <Amended June 10, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 전문교육의 이수시간은 다음 각 호와 같다. <신설 2021. 6. 10.>
rows.text_en: ③ The hours of completion for specialized training shall be as follows: <Newly added June 10, 2021>
1. Professional Training for Administrators: 7 hours or more
2. Specialized Training for Practitioners: 14 hours or more

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 전문교육의 교육과정 운영 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 행정안전부장관이 정한다. <개정 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26., 2021. 6. 10.>
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the operation of the curriculum, etc., of specialized education shall be determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety. <Amended Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017; Jun. 10, 2021>
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(긴급안전점검 대상 시설ㆍ지역 관리카드) 영 제38조제5항에 따른 긴급안전점검 대상 시설 및 지역의 관리에 관한 카드는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다. <개정 2023. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Management Card for Facilities and Areas Subject to Emergency Safety Inspection) The card regarding the management of facilities and areas subject to emergency safety inspection pursuant to Article 38, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form. <Amended Dec. 12, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(재난안전관리원증) 법 제30조제4항에 따라 긴급안전점검을 하는 공무원의 권한을 표시하는 증표는 별지 제10호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Disaster Safety Management Officer Certificate) The identification card indicating the authority of a public official conducting an emergency safety inspection pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(안전조치명령서) 영 제39조제1항에 따른 안전조치명령서는 별지 제11호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Order for Safety Measures) The order for safety measures pursuant to Article 39, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 11 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(안전조치 결과의 통보) 법 제31조제1항에 따른 안전조치명령을 받은 소유자ㆍ관리자 또는 점유자는 같은 조 제2항에 따라 안전조치를 하였을 때에는 별지 제12호서식의 안전조치 결과 통보서에 안전조치 결과를 증명할 수 있는 서류ㆍ사진 등을 첨부하여 행정안전부장관 또는 해당 재난관리책임기관의 장에게 통보하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 2. 7., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Notification of Results of Safety Measures) Whenan owner, manager, or occupant who has received a safety measure order pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 1 of the Act has taken safety measures pursuant to Paragraph 2 of the same Article, they shall notify the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of the relevant disaster management agency by attaching documents, photographs, etc., that can prove the results of the safety measures to the Notification of Results of Safety Measures in the Form No. 12 of the Appendix . <Amended Feb. 7, 2014; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(안전조치의 안내) 법 제31조제3항 후단에 따라 행정안전부장관 또는 재난관리책임기관의 장이 게시하여야 하는 제한 또는 금지 사항에 관한 내용은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2014. 2. 7., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Guidance on Safety Measures) The contents regarding matters of restriction or prohibition that the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of the disaster management agency responsible for disaster management must post pursuant to the latter part of Article 31 , Paragraph 3 of the Act are as follows: <Amended Feb. 7, 2014; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>
1. Facility Name
2. Owner, manager, or occupant
3. Date of Designation and Designated Grade
4. Restrictions or Prohibitions

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 재난예방을 위하여 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters necessary for disaster prevention
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의2(재난안전분야 제도개선) ① 법 제31조의3제1항에 따라 행정안전부장관으로부터 재난안전분야 제도개선 과제(이하 “개선과제”라 한다)의 이행 요청을 받은 재난관리주관기관의 장은 같은 조 제3항에 따라 14일 이내에 개선과제의 수용 여부를 행정안전부장관에게 통보해야 한다. 다만, 부득이한 사유가 있으면 7일의 범위에서 연장할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-2 (Institutional Improvement in the Disaster Safety Sector) ① The head of the disaster management agency who has received a request from the Minister of the Interior and Safety for the implementation of institutional improvement tasks in the disaster safety sector (hereinafter referred to as “improvement tasks”) pursuant to Article 31-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall notify the Minister of the Interior and Safety of whether or not to accept the improvement tasks within 14 days pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article . However, if there are unavoidable circumstances, the period may be extended within the range of 7 days.

rows.source_ko: ② 재난관리주관기관의 장은 법 제31조의3제1항에 따라 이행 요청을 받은 개선과제가 수용하기 곤란한 특별한 사유가 있는 경우 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함하여 행정안전부장관에게 통보해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If there are special reasons why it is difficult to accept an improvement task for which an implementation request has been received pursuant to Article 31-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the head of the disaster management agency shall notify the Minister of the Interior and Safety, including the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.
1. Reasons why it is difficult to accept the improvement task
2. Problems arising from the acceptance of improvement tasks
3. Review of Alternatives for Improvement Tasks

rows.source_ko: ③ 행정안전부장관은 제2항에 따라 재난관리주관기관의 장이 개선과제의 이행이 곤란하다고 통보하는 경우 재난관리주관기관 및 관계 전문가 등과 합동으로 검토 회의를 개최할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the head of the disaster management agency notifies that it is difficult to implement improvement tasks pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister of Public Safety and Security may hold a joint review meeting with the disaster management agency and relevant experts, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 26, 2024]
Article 11-3 Deleted <January 17, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제11조의4(재난문자방송에 대한 기준ㆍ운영 등) ① 영 제46조의2제3항에 따른 재난문자방송(이하 “재난문자방송”이라 한다)에는 태풍ㆍ호우(豪雨)ㆍ대설ㆍ산불 등의 재난이 발생할 경우에 대비한 행동요령 등이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-4 (Standards and Operation, etc. for Disaster Text Broadcasting) ① Disaster text broadcasting pursuant to Article 46-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as “disaster text broadcasting”) shall include guidelines for action in preparation for the occurrence of disasters such as typhoons, heavy rain, heavy snow, and forest fires.

rows.source_ko: ② 재난문자방송과 관계되는 재난관리책임기관의 장은 재난이 발생하거나 발생할 우려가 있을 때에는 재난정보를 중앙대책본부장에게 제공하여야 하며, 중앙대책본부장은 영 제46조의2제1항제5호의 전기통신사업자에게 재난정보를 재난문자방송으로 송출하도록 요청할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 2. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of a disaster management agency responsible for disaster text broadcasting shall provide disaster information to the Head of the Central Disaster Management Headquarters when a disaster occurs or is likely to occur, and the Head of the Central Disaster Management Headquarters may request a telecommunications business operator referred to in Article 46-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree to transmit the disaster information via disaster text broadcasting. <Amended Feb. 7, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항과 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 재난문자방송의 기준 및 운영에 필요한 세부 사항은 행정안전부장관이 정한다. 다만, 지진ㆍ지진해일ㆍ화산에 대한 재난문자방송의 기준 및 운영에 필요한 세부 사항은 기상청장이 정한다. <개정 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26., 2020. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, detailed matters necessary for the standards and operation of disaster text message broadcasting shall be determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety . However, detailed matters necessary for the standards and operation of disaster text message broadcasting regarding earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanoes shall be determined by the Administrator of the Korea Meteorological Administration . <Amended Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017; Jan. 7, 2020>

[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]
[Moved from Article 11-2 <Feb. 7, 2014>]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(동원 요청) 법 제39조제1항 및 영 제48조에 따른 동원발령 요청은 별지 제13호서식의 동원발령 요청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Request for Mobilization) A request for a mobilization order pursuant to Article 39 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 48 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made in accordance with the request for a mobilization order form in Annex 13 .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제12조의2(재난관리자원의 응원) 영 제51조의2제1항 및 제3항에 따른 응원 요청 및 응원 요청에 대한 동의 통보 등에 관한 서식은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-2 (Support for Disaster Management Resources) The forms for the request for support and the notification of consent to the request for support, etc., pursuant to Article 51-2, Paragraphs 1 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree are as follows:
1. Request for Support from Disaster Management Resources: Attached Form No. 13-2

rows.source_ko: 2. 재난관리자원의 응원 동의 통보서: 별지 제13호의3서식
rows.text_en: 2. Notification of Consent to Support Disaster Management Resources: Attached Form No. 13-3
3. Confirmation of Support for Disaster Management Resources: Form No. 13-4
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(응급조치종사 명령서 등) ① 영 제52조제1항 본문에 따른 응급조치종사 명령서는 별지 제14호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Order for Engagement in Emergency Measures, etc.) ① The order for engagement in emergency measures pursuant to the main text of Article 52, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 14 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제52조제1항 단서에 따른 응급조치종사 확인서는 별지 제15호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The confirmation of service in emergency measures pursuant to the proviso of Article 52, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 15 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제52조제2항 본문에 따른 응급부담 명령서는 별지 제16호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The order for emergency burden pursuant to the main text of Article 52, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 16 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제52조제2항 단서에 따른 응급부담 확인서는 별지 제17호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ④ The confirmation of emergency burden pursuant to the proviso of Article 52, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 17 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(지원금의 지급신청) 영 제58조제2항에 따른 민간긴급구조지원기관의 지원금 지급신청은 별지 제18호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Application for Payment of Support Funds) An application for the payment of support funds by a private emergency rescue support agency pursuant to Article 58, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 18 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(지휘권 이양 협의서) 영 제59조제2항에 따른 지휘권 이양 협의 결과의 작성은 별지 제19호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Consultation on Transfer of Command Authority) The results of the consultation on the transfer of command authority pursuant to Article 59, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be prepared in accordance with Form No. 19 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(긴급구조의 교육) ① 영 제66조제2항에 따른 재난관리업무에 종사하는 사람에 대한 긴급구조에 관한 교육 내용은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2017. 2. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Emergency Rescue Training) ①The contents of emergency rescue training for persons engaged in disaster management duties pursuant to Article 66 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as follows: <Amended Feb. 3, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 긴급구조대응계획 및 긴급구조세부대응계획의 수립ㆍ집행 및 운용방법
rows.text_en: 1. Methods for Establishing, Executing, and Operating Emergency Rescue Response Plans and Detailed Emergency Rescue Response Plans
2. Administrative Practices for Disaster Response
3. Emergency Disaster Response Theory and Technology

rows.source_ko: 4. 긴급구조활동에 필요한 인명구조, 응급처치, 건축물구조 안전조치, 특수재난 대응방법 및 법 제49조제1항에 따른 중앙긴급구조통제단의 단장(이하 “중앙통제단장”이라 한다)이 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Life-saving, first aid, structural safety measures for buildings, and special disaster response methods necessary for emergency rescue activities, and matters deemed necessary by the Head of the Central Emergency Rescue Control Center pursuant to Article 49, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Head of the Central Control Center”).

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 교육은 다음 각 호의 과정으로 구분하여 시행하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 2. 3.>
rows.text_en: ② The education under Paragraph 1 shall be implemented by classifying it into the courses of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Feb. 3, 2017>
1. Emergency Rescue Response Activities Practitioner Training Course
2. Emergency Rescue Response Administrative Practitioner Course
3. Emergency Rescue Response Field Commander Course
4. Training courses deemed necessary by the Head of the Central Control Group

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 법 제16조제2항에 따른 시ㆍ도재난안전대책본부의 본부장 및 시ㆍ군ㆍ구재난안전대책본부의 본부장과 법 제50조제2항에 따른 시ㆍ도긴급구조통제단의 단장 및 시ㆍ군ㆍ구긴급구조통제단의 단장이 필요하다고 인정하는 교육과정
rows.text_en: 5. Other training courses deemed necessary by the heads of the City/Provincial Disaster and Safety Countermeasure Headquarters and City/County/District Disaster and Safety Countermeasure Headquarters pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Act , and by the heads of the City/Provincial Emergency Rescue Control Centers and City/County/District Emergency Rescue Control Centers pursuant to Article 50, Paragraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제55조제4항에 따라 소방청장 또는 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)는 긴급구조에 관한 교육을 담당할 교육기관을 지정하려는 경우에는 해당 기관의 장으로 하여금 긴급구조교육과정 운영계획을 제출하도록 할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 2. 7., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 2. 3., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ Pursuant to Article 55, Paragraph 4 of the Act , when the Commissioner of the National Fire Agency or the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, or Governor of a Province or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/Governor”) intends to designate an educational institution responsible for training on emergency rescue, they may require the head of the relevant institution to submit a plan for the operation of an emergency rescue training course. <Amended Feb. 7, 2014; Nov. 19, 2014; Feb. 3, 2017; Jul. 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 긴급구조에 관한 교육의 운영 등에 필요한 세부 사항은 소방청장이 정하여 고시한다. <신설 2017. 2. 3., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters necessary for the operation, etc. of education regarding emergency rescue shall be determined and announced by the Commissioner of the National Fire Agency . <Newly added Feb. 3, 2017; Jul. 26, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(재난합동조사단의 편성 및 운영 등) ① 영 제67조제4항에 따라 법 제58조제3항에 따른 중앙재난피해합동조사단(이하 “재난피해조사단”이라 한다)을 편성하는 경우에는 관계 부처 공무원 및 민간전문가를 포함시킬 수 있다. <개정 2014. 2. 7., 2015. 8. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Organization and Operation of the Joint Disaster Investigation Team, etc.) ①pursuant to Article 58, Paragraph 3 of the Act, in accordance with Article 67 , Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, public officials from relevant ministries and private sector experts may be included. <Amended Feb. 7, 2014; Aug. 11, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 재난피해조사단은 현지조사에 필요한 정보를 사전에 확보하기 위하여 관계 재난관리책임기관의 장에게 관련 자료를 요청할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 2. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The Disaster Damage Investigation Team may request relevant data from the heads of relevant disaster management agencies to secure information necessary for on-site investigations in advance. <Amended Feb. 7, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ③ 재난피해조사단의 조사 시기 및 기간 등은 재난의 유형, 피해 규모 및 현지 여건에 따라 달리 정할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 2. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ The timing and duration of the investigation by the disaster damage investigation team may be determined differently depending on the type of disaster, the scale of damage, and local conditions. <Amended Feb. 7, 2014>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 재난피해조사단의 운영에 필요한 세부 사항은 중앙대책본부장이 정한다. <개정 2014. 2. 7.>
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters necessary for the operation of the Disaster Damage Investigation Team shall be determined by the Head of the Central Disaster Countermeasure Headquarters . <Amended Feb. 7, 2014>

[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]
[Moved from Article 18-2 <Feb. 7, 2014>]
Article 18 Deleted <June 4, 2020>
Article 18-2
[Formerly Article 18-2 moved to Article 17 <February 7, 2014>]

rows.source_ko: 제19조(재결신청서) 영 제71조제2항에 따른 재결신청서는 별지 제20호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Application for Reconsideration) The application for reconsideration pursuant to Article 71 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 20 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 6, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의2(지방자치단체의 재난복구 비용 부담기준) 법 제66조제2항에 따른 지방자치단체의 부담금 중 시ㆍ도 및 시ㆍ군ㆍ구가 부담하는 기준은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2019. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 19-2 (Standards for Bearing Disaster Recovery Costs by Local Governments) The standards for the burden borne by Cities, Provinces, and Cities, Counties, and Districts among the levies imposed by local governments pursuant to Article 66, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended July 26, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 자연재난: 「자연재난 구호 및 복구 비용 부담기준 등에 관한 규칙」 제2조에 따른 비율에 따라 부담
rows.text_en: 1. Natural disasters: Burdened according to the ratio under Article 2 of the "Rules on Standards for Bearing Costs, etc. for Natural Disaster Relief and Recovery"

rows.source_ko: 2. 사회재난: 시ㆍ군ㆍ구의 부담률이 50퍼센트를 넘지 아니하는 범위에서 시ㆍ도의 조례로 정하는 비율에 따라 부담
rows.text_en: 2. Social disasters: Burden shall be borne according to the rate determined by the ordinance of the City or Province, within a range where the burden rate of the City, County, or District does not exceed 50 percent.
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 7, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의3(복구비 등의 반환명령) 법 제66조에 따른 재난의 구호 및 복구를 위하여 지원하는 비용(이하 “복구비등”이라 한다)을 직접 지급한 국가기관의 장 또는 지방자치단체의 장은 복구비등을 받은 자가 법 제66조의3제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 그 사실을 안 날부터 7일 이내에 별지 제20호의2서식에 따른 복구비등 반납 고지서를 그 당사자에게 발송하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-3 (Order for Return of Recovery Costs, etc.) The head of a state agency or a local government that has directly paid the costs provided for disaster relief and recovery pursuant to Article 66 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “recovery costs, etc.”) shall, if the person who received the recovery costs, etc. falls under any of the subparagraphs of Article 66-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act , send a notice of return of recovery costs, etc. in accordance with Form No. 20-2 of the Appendix to the person concerned within 7 days from the date of becoming aware of such fact.

[This Article was newly added on Jan. 18, 2018.]
[Formerly Article 19-3 was moved to Article 19-8 <Jan. 18, 2018>]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의4(지역축제 안전관리계획 제출) 법 제66조의11제3항 및 영 제73조의9제6항에 따라 지역축제를 개최하려는 자가 제출해야 하는 지역축제 안전관리계획서는 별지 제20호의3서식과 같다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 19-4 (Submission of Regional Festival Safety Management Plan) Pursuant to Article 66-11 , Paragraph 3 of the Act and Article 73-9, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree , the regional festival safety management plan to be submitted by a person intending to hold a regional festival shall be in accordance with Form No. 20-3 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

[This Article was newly added on June 4, 2020.]
[Formerly Article 19-4 was moved to Article 19-5 <June 4, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의5(재난원인조사 등) ① 영 제75조의3제7항에 따른 재난원인조사의 구분은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2020. 6. 4., 2023. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 19-5 (Investigation into Causes of Disasters, etc.) ① The classifications of investigations into the causes of disasters pursuant to Article 75-3, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree are as follows: <Amended June 4, 2020; June 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 예비조사 : 재난ㆍ사고 발생 시 상황파악, 본조사의 필요성 판단 및 본조사를 위한 자료 수집
rows.text_en: 1. Preliminary Investigation: Situation assessment in the event of a disaster or accident, determination of the necessity for the main investigation, and collection of data for the main investigation

rows.source_ko: 2. 본조사 : 재난ㆍ사고의 발생원인, 대응과정, 위험요인, 피해확대요인 등의 조사ㆍ분석, 재발방지를 위한 개선권고 도출
rows.text_en: 2. Main Investigation: Investigation and analysis of the causes of disasters and accidents, response processes, risk factors, and factors contributing to damage amplification, and derivation of recommendations for improvement to prevent recurrence.

rows.source_ko: ② 재난관리책임기관의 장은 법 제69조제1항에 따라 재난원인조사를 실시한 경우에는 조사결과보고서 작성을 완료한 날부터 10일 이내에 그 조사결과보고서를 행정안전부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the head of a disaster management agency conducts an investigation into the cause of a disaster pursuant to Article 69, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she must submit the investigation result report to the Minister of the Interior and Safety within 10 days from the date the report is completed.

rows.source_ko: ③ 행정안전부장관은 법 제69조제1항에 따라 직접 재난원인조사를 실시하거나 법 제69조제2항에 따라 정부합동 재난원인조사단을 편성하여 재난원인조사를 실시하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함해 재난원인조사 실시 계획을 작성해야 한다. <개정 2020. 6. 4., 2023. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ Where the Minister of the Interior and Safety conducts a direct investigation into the cause of a disaster pursuant to Article 69, Paragraph 1 of the Act , or organizes a joint government investigation team pursuant to Article 69, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the Minister shall prepare a plan for the implementation of the investigation into the cause of a disaster, including the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 4, 2020; June 28, 2023>
1. Necessity of Disaster Cause Investigation

rows.source_ko: 2. 조사 기간, 조사 방법 및 절차에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the investigation period, investigation methods, and procedures

rows.source_ko: 3. 조사단장 및 조사단 편성안(영 제75조의3제16항에 따라 재난원인조사반을 편성하는 경우 조사반장 및 조사반 편성안을 말한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Proposal for the Head of the Investigation Team and the Organization of the Investigation Team ( referring to the proposal for the Head of the Investigation Team and the Organization of the Investigation Team in cases where a disaster cause investigation team is organized pursuant to Article 75-3 , Paragraph 16 of the Enforcement Decree)
4. Status of Past Similar Accidents

rows.source_ko: ④ 행정안전부장관은 영 제75조의3제10항 및 제11항에 따른 개선권고에 따른 조치계획 및 조치결과를 별지 제20호의4서식에 따른 재난원인조사 후속조치 이행관리카드로 작성하여 체계적으로 관리해야 한다. <개정 2020. 6. 4., 2023. 6. 28.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall systematically manage the action plan and results of measures taken pursuant to the recommendation for improvement under Paragraphs 10 and 11 of Article 75-3 of the Enforcement Decree by preparing an Implementation Management Card for Follow-up Measures to the Disaster Cause Investigation in accordance with Form No. 20-4 of the Appendix . <Amended June 4, 2020; June 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제75조의3제16항에 따른 재난원인조사반은 법 제69조제1항에 따라 실시한 재난원인조사의 결과와 영 제75조의3제10항 및 제11항에 따른 개선권고에 따른 조치계획 및 조치결과를 조정위원회에 보고할 수 있다. <개정 2020. 6. 4., 2023. 6. 28., 2024. 6. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The disaster cause investigation team pursuant to Article 75-3, Paragraph 16 of the Enforcement Decree may report to the Coordination Committee the results of the disaster cause investigation conducted pursuant to Article 69, Paragraph 1 of the Act , as well as the action plan and results of measures taken in accordance with the recommendations for improvement pursuant to Article 75-3 , Paragraphs 10 and 11 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended June 4, 2020; June 28, 2023; June 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항부터 제5항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 재난원인조사에 필요한 사항은 행정안전부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 5, matters necessary for the investigation of the cause of disaster shall be determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety .

[This Article newly inserted Jan. 7, 2020]
[Moved from Article 19-4; former Article 19-5 moved to Article 19-6 <June 4, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의6(연구개발사업 성과의 사업화에 필요한 사항) 법 제72조제1항제5호에서 “행정안전부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-6 (Matters necessary for the commercialization of research and development project results) The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety” in Article 72 , Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the Act refers to any of the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 연구개발사업 성과의 사업화를 촉진하기 위한 법률ㆍ세무ㆍ회계 등의 자문
rows.text_en: 1. Consulting on legal, tax, and accounting matters to facilitate the commercialization of R&D project outcomes

rows.source_ko: 2. 연구개발사업 성과의 사업화로 생산된 제품 등에 대한 홍보
rows.text_en: 2. Promotion of products, etc. produced through the commercialization of R&D project results

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 행정안전부장관이 연구개발사업 성과의 사업화 지원을 위해 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of the Interior and Safety to support the commercialization of research and development project results

[This Article was newly added on Jan. 7, 2020]
[Moved from Article 22 on July 1, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의7(정보 제공 요청 서식) 영 제83조의2제1항에 따라 정보의 제공을 요청하려는 행정안전부장관(법 제14조제1항에 따른 중앙대책본부가 운영되는 경우에는 해당 본부장을 말한다), 시ㆍ도지사(법 제16조제1항에 따른 시ㆍ도대책본부가 운영되는 경우에는 해당 본부장을 말한다) 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(법 제16조제1항에 따른 시ㆍ군ㆍ구대책본부가 운영되는 경우에는 해당 본부장을 말한다)은 별지 제20호의9서식의 정보 제공 요청서를 작성하여 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-7 (Form for Requesting Information Provision) Any Minister of the Interior and Safety (referring tothe head of the relevant headquarters in cases where a central countermeasures headquarters is operated pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act ), a mayor or provincial governor (referring to the head of the relevant headquarters in cases where a provincial countermeasures headquarters is operated pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Act ), or a mayor, county head, or district head (referring to the head of the relevant headquarters incases where a city, county, or district countermeasures headquarters is operated pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Act ) who intends to request the provision of information pursuant to Article 83-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall complete and submit a request for information provision form in Annex 20-9 .

[Wholly Amended Jun. 26, 2024]
[Moved from Article 19-10 <July 1, 2025>]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의8(공인재난관리사 자격시험의 응시원서) 영 제83조의10제4항에 따른 공인재난관리사 자격시험의 응시원서(전자문서로 된 원서를 포함한다)는 별지 제22호서식에 따른다. <개정 2025. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 19-8 (Application Form for Certified Disaster Manager Qualification Examination) The application form for the Certified Disaster Manager qualification examination pursuant to Article 83-10, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree (including applications in the form of electronic documents) shall be in accordance with Form No. 22 of the Attached Form . <Amended July 1, 2025>

[This Article was newly added on Mar. 19, 2025.]
[Moved from Article 23 on July 1, 2025.]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의9(공인재난관리사 자격시험에 합격한 사람에 대한 연수과정) ① 법 제75조의3제1항에 따른 공인재난관리사 자격시험에 합격한 사람에 대한 연수과정(이하 “연수과정”이라 한다)은 재난의 예방ㆍ대비ㆍ대응ㆍ복구 등의 업무를 효율적으로 수행할 수 있는 능력과 전문성을 함양할 수 있는 내용으로 실시한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-9 (Training Course for Persons Who Have Passed the Certified Disaster Manager Qualification Examination) ① The training course for persons who have passed the Certified Disaster Manager Qualification Examination pursuant to Article 75-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “training course”) shall be conducted with content that can cultivate the ability and expertise to efficiently perform duties such as disaster prevention, preparedness, response, and recovery.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제88조제3항에 따라 행정안전부장관으로부터 법 제75조의3제1항에 따른 연수 실시에 관한 업무를 위탁받은 비영리법인 등(이하 “연수실시기관”이라 한다)의 장은 연수과정의 방법ㆍ절차 등 연수 실시에 필요한 사항을 포함한 연수과정 운영계획을 작성하고, 행정안전부장관에게 보고한 후 운영한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 88, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the head of a non-profit corporation, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “training implementing institution”) entrusted by the Minister of the Interior and Safety with the duties regarding the implementation of training under Article 75-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall prepare a training course operation plan including matters necessary for the implementation of training, such as the methods and procedures of the training course, and operate it after reporting it to the Minister of the Interior and Safety.

rows.source_ko: ③ 연수실시기관의 장은 해당 연수과정을 마친 날부터 7일 이내에 연수과정을 수료한 사람의 명단 등 연수 결과를 행정안전부장관에게 보고한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the training implementing institution shall report the results of the training, including the list of persons who completed the training course, to the Minister of the Interior and Safety within 7 days from the date the training course was completed.

[This Article was newly added on Mar. 19, 2025.]
[Moved from Article 24 on July 1, 2025.]

rows.source_ko: 제19조의10(공인재난관리사 자격증의 발급 등) ① 법 제75조의3제1항에 따라 공인재난관리사 자격시험에 합격하고 연수과정을 수료한 사람으로서 공인재난관리사 자격증을 발급받으려는 사람은 별지 제23호서식의 공인재난관리사 자격증 발급 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 행정안전부장관(영 제88조제3항에 따라 자격증 교부에 관한 업무를 위탁한 경우에는 그 업무를 위탁받은 자를 말하며, 이하 “자격증발급기관”이라 한다)에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19-10 (Issuance of Certified Disaster Manager Qualification Certificate, etc.) ①A person who has passed the Certified Disaster Manager qualification examination and completed the training course pursuant to Article 75-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act and who wishes to obtain a Certified Disaster Manager qualification certificate shall submit an application for the issuance of a Certified Disaster Manager qualification certificate in the form of Annex No. 23, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of the Interior and Safety (in cases where the duties regarding the issuance of qualification certificates have been entrusted pursuant to Article 88, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, this refers to the person entrusted with such duties; hereinafter referred to as the “qualification certificate issuing agency”).

rows.source_ko: 1. 신분증 사본 등 본인을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents verifying identity, such as a copy of an ID card

rows.source_ko: 2. 최근 6개월 이내에 촬영한 모자를 쓰지 않은 정면 상반신 사진(3.5센티미터 × 4.5센티미터) 2장
rows.text_en: 2. Two front-facing upper-body photographs (3.5 cm × 4.5 cm) taken within the last 6 months without a hat

rows.source_ko: 3. 연수과정을 수료하였다는 사실을 증명할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving completion of the training course

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청서를 받은 자격증발급기관은 신청서를 제출받은 날부터 14일 이내에 별지 제24호서식의 공인재난관리사 자격증(상장형) 및 별지 제25호서식의 공인재난관리사 자격증(카드형)을 발급하고, 별지 제26호서식의 공인재난관리사 자격증 발급대장에 그 사실을 기재한다.

rows.source_ko: 제21조(포상금의 지급 기준 등) ① 영 제87조제2항에 따라 행정안전부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(이하 “포상금지급자”라 한다)이 지급하는 포상금의 지급 기준은 다음 각 호의 사항 등을 고려하여 포상금지급자가 정한다. <개정 2017. 2. 3., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Standards for Payment of Rewards, etc.) ① The standards for payment of rewards made by the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (hereinafter referred to as the “Reward Payer”) pursuant to Article 87 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be determined by the Reward Payer in consideration of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, etc. <Amended Feb. 3, 2017; Jul. 26, 2017>
1. Contribution to disaster and safety management
2. Participation in safety culture dissemination activities
3. Participation in safety-related reporting
4. Social Interest

rows.text_en: ② The payer of the reward may constitute and operate a Reward Payment Deliberation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Deliberation Committee”) to deliberate on matters concerning whether to pay the reward and the amount thereof, pursuant to Article 87, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended Feb. 3, 2017>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  The Rules on Emergency Rescue Response Activities and On-site Command are partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 4, item (c), “Emergency Rescue Command Unit (hereinafter referred to as “Emergency Rescue Command Unit”)” shall be changed to “Emergency Rescue Field Command Unit (hereinafter referred to as “Emergency Rescue Field Command Unit”)”.

rows.source_ko: 제16조의 제목 “(긴급구조지휘대의 구성 및 기능)”을 “(긴급구조현장지휘대의 구성 및 기능)”으로 하고, 같은 조 제1항 중 “긴급구조지휘대는”을 각각 “긴급구조현장지휘대는”으로 하며, 같은 조 제2항 각 호 외의 부분 및 같은 조 제3항 각 호 외의 부분 중 “긴급구조지휘대”를 각각 “긴급구조현장지휘대”로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title of Article 16, “(Composition and Functions of the Emergency Rescue Command Team),” shall be changed to “(Composition and Functions of the Emergency Rescue Field Command Team),” and in Paragraph 1 of the same article, “the Emergency Rescue Command Team” shall be replaced with “the Emergency Rescue Field Command Team,” and in the part other than the subparagraphs of Paragraph 2 and Paragraph 3 of the same article, “the Emergency Rescue Command Team” shall be replaced with “the Emergency Rescue Field Command Team.”
In Article 24, Paragraph 5, “Emergency Rescue Command Team” shall be changed to “Emergency Rescue Field Command Team.”
In Article 39, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2, “Emergency Rescue Command Team” shall be changed to “Emergency Rescue Field Command Team.”

rows.source_ko: 별표 3 제2호의 대응계획부의 통합지휘ㆍ조정란 나목 중 “긴급구조지휘대”를 “긴급구조현장지휘대”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In subparagraph (b) of the Integrated Command and Coordination column of the Response Planning Department in Appendix 3, Item 2, “Emergency Rescue Command Unit” shall be changed to “Emergency Rescue Field Command Unit.”
In the title of Appendix 5, “Emergency Rescue Command Unit” shall be changed to “Emergency Rescue Field Command Unit”.
